submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the front free anatomical LEFT knee-to-boot chain of the exact ice-sword girl sprite in image 1 (frame E08). Output one square transparent PNG sprite, native >=1024. Preserve image1 head, hairstyle, all robe/sleeve details, upper-body pose, right-hand sword, left-hand blue talisman, camera scale, whole-canvas registration and exact rear RIGHT support leg position. Image2 is the preceding revised E07; image3 is the next E09 landing. Image4 locks existing project art style, and image5 is gait reference only: no external character or background copying.
Make this the next independent compact swing pose after image2: the free front left knee remains softly bent; its shin is carried modestly closer under that knee rather than flung far screen-right in a split kick. Place the left boot a little farther forward and lower than image2's boot, preparing to settle toward image3. It still remains airborne at E08; right rear forefoot remains the supporting foot. Point left boot toe SCREEN RIGHT, nearly level sole with only slight natural pitch, no large underside-facing-camera panel and no outward ankle swivel. Keep exactly two natural connected legs, align knee–ankle–shoe within the sagittal eastward movement plane. Rear heel may be lifted for push-off but rear forefoot stays down. Do not switch feet, mirror, globally move character, add hands, weapons, shadow, text, checkerboard or scenery. Preserve transparent background and uncropped extremities.
